limits: API reads remain sequential, not atomic with writes or revocation.

After merge does not recollect other reviews or branch protections and does not reverify artifact/source contents, validation signature or deployed generation; future service must enforce those obligations before authorizing a decision.
The manifest reader must still compare every consumed artifact and source to the signed attestation; this helper does not supply that missing validator.
Native Forgejo API shape/scope/permission and atomic merge behavior are not proved by these invented response tests.
Revocation observed after merge withholds a future delivery decision; no attempt to undo Git history is made.
reviewed_properties: Before merge refreshes all review pages through the existing strict collector, revalidates the actual validation envelope signature and exact manifest/review binding, and refuses expired or changed prior binding.
Final individual selected review reread checks reviewer membership and technical exclusion, official APPROVED state, dismissal/staleness, head, update timestamp and exact approval body.

After merge requires an already verified binding, same review policy hash and unexpired policy/binding, closed non-draft merged PR, expected head as merge commit, current main equal to that head and unchanged selected approval.
Returns only an unsigned postmerge observation with head/review ID/time; supplies no write transport, merge request, signature or authority.
scope: independent local code and author-test review, no test rerun, HTTP, merge or deployment
